name: Just A Room
description: A room. An ordinary one, with the last of the beat going out of it. You are standing up holding a balloon and the enormous thing you understood forty seconds ago has left no forwarding address. It was going to change everything.

objects.name: the balloon
looks: Slack. In your hand. You look a bit of a fool.
There is a little left in it and there is no point.
It is a balloon. You had been thinking of it as a doorway.

objects.name: what you understood
looks: Nothing. There is a shape where it was.
It was about everything and it was completely clear.
You could get it back for another one of those. That is the trick of it.

ambient: The last of the beat leaves the room.
Somewhere a normal sound happens at a normal speed.
You become aware of your own face and where it is.
